decisions.quote: In this paper, we report two attempts to replicate Boroditsky et al.’s results.
decisions.reason: Both shipped and blind coding identify this study as a replication. The paper collects new data across two experiments (a word association task in Experiment 1 and a primed lexical decision task in Experiment 2) to re-test the finding reported in Boroditsky et al. (2003).

The actual target re-tested by both experiments is Boroditsky, Schmidt & Phillips (2003), 'Sex, syntax, and semantics', matching blind target 0.

decisions.quote: We were not able to replicate the results either in a word association task or in an analogous primed lexical decision task.
decisions.reason: Once original identity is resolved to Boroditsky, Schmidt & Phillips (2003), both shipped and blind coding agree on the outcome 'failed'. The authors explicitly state in the title, abstract, and general discussion that both experimental attempts failed to replicate Boroditsky et al.'s (2003) results.
